name: UWaterloo IISE
description: Waterloo chapter of IISE, the world's largest professional society for the industrial & systems engineering profession.

cycles.notes: General involvement is open any time: join the mailing list, come to events, or email info@uwaterlooiise.ca. The site's Get Involved page says they aren't hiring for committee positions right now, those job descriptions are expected to go live near the end of the spring term, that's about exec roles, not general membership.
